nodes.summary: The equation $x^3 + y^6 = z^2$ has a solution in nonzero integers, namely $2^3 + 1^6 = 3^2$.
nodes.title: A solution of x³ + y⁶ = z²

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $m$, $n$, $r$, the equation $x^m + y^n = z^r$ is called solvable when there are nonzero integers $x$, $y$, $z$ with $x^m + y^n = z^r$.
nodes.title: Solvable generalized Fermat equation

nodes.summary: Let $s, t, w$ be positive integers. If $s, t, w$ are pairwise coprime, $s$ is odd and $3 \nmid w$, then the equation $x^{3s} + y^{6t} = z^{2w}$ has infinitely many solutions $(x, y, z)$ in nonzero integers; otherwise it has no solution in nonzero integers.
nodes.title: Generalized Fermat equations with exponents 3s, 6t and 2w

nodes.summary: Let $m, n, r \ge 2$ be integers with $\gcd(m, n, r) = 1$ such that at least two of $\gcd(m, n)$, $\gcd(m, r)$ and $\gcd(n, r)$ are greater than $1$. Suppose there are no natural numbers $s, t, w$ that are pairwise coprime, with $s$ odd and $3 \nmid w$, such that $(m, n, r)$ is one of $(3s, 6t, 2w)$, $(6t, 3s, 2w)$, $(2w, 3s, 6t)$ and $(3s, 2w, 6t)$. Then the equation $x^m + y^n = z^r$ has no solution in nonzero…
nodes.title: Generalized Fermat equations with two non-coprime pairs of exponents

nodes.summary: Let $p \le q$ be primes with $p \ge 5$, and let $x, y, z$ be pairwise coprime nonzero integers. Then $x^p + y^p \ne z^q$.
nodes.title: The Bartolomé–Mihăilescu theorem for prime exponents

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $m$, $n$, $r$, if $x^m + y^n = z^r$ has a solution in nonzero integers, then so does $x^n + y^m = z^r$.
nodes.title: Swapping the first two exponents of a generalized Fermat equation

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
